message.content: {"note_claim": "The claim that USAID gave Chelsea Clinton tens of millions of dollars (via the Clinton Foundation) is false and has been debunked by fact checks.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "In short, Chelsea Clinton has not received $84 million from USAID.", "reason": "Snopes rates the similar claim false, showing USAID gave the Clinton Foundation no money from FY2008-2024 and Chelsea Clinton receives no compensation, directly substantiating the note's debunking."}
